_workflow: To add a new event: append an entry to the events array. isoDateTime uses YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss in US Central Time. expiryDays controls how long the expiration message shows: 1 = expires midnight of arrival day, 2 = expires midnight of the following day. Redeploy after saving — no code changes needed.
_tz_note: All times are US Central. Stored as local ISO — browser interprets in local timezone.
